author: sonnet
label: baseline-dev-01
changes: Added a short glossary in the Summary (the store, pod, security on-call, version id) so a reader new to the project can follow.
Rewrote the Summary to state the current state, the two halves, and why there are no customer errors.

Fixed the step 3 note about automatic deploys: step 4 depends on the step 3 image, so it cannot precede the merge. Now says steps 2 and 4 must be done before an auto-deploying merge, with a matching update in Open questions.
Moved the confirmation of A1 and A3 into the 'What moves' list of step 1, where it is an action, instead of the failure section.
Added cross-references (step numbers) in step 3 so each change names the step that describes it.
Clarified the step 6 sequence: compare reported versions, then wait 10 minutes, then check last-used times.
Simplified step 8's trigger wording ('after this point no pre-migration image can work') and the step 9 rollback explanation.
Dropped the 'version 1' detail and other minor wording that added no information; tightened sentences throughout.
Corrected 'Step 5 / 10' and 'Step 13' references in the failure summary to read consistently, and the step 8 row to say step 6 should block it.
Clarified in step 12 that import-time client singletons can stay because they hold no key, and in step 14 that the fake source is refused outside APP_ENV=local.
Rewrote the Summary to explain Part A (rollout) versus Part B (runtime) in plain terms and noted what the old design prevented (key could never change without redeploy).
Expanded the terms list: added readiness probe, SecretProvider, canary and KMS context, and gave an example secret path.
Added an 'order at a glance' line at the top of Part A and an orientation paragraph at the top of Part B.
Step 1: stated that orders-api-prod gets read-only access to the prod path and nothing else, matching the brief.
Step 3: clarified the automatic-deploy caveat in the failure case into a single, clearer sentence.
Step 10: replaced Kubernetes with the cluster, consistent with the rest of the document.
Step 11: replaced kubelet with the cluster.
Failure summary: added the missing step 6 row.
Minor wording tightening throughout; no change to the plan's intent, requirements or format.
Reworded the opening summary and glossary so each term (store, pod, probe, canary, SecretProvider) is defined once, plainly, before use
Tightened wording across all steps while keeping the four fields (starts when, what moves, state lives in, if it fails)
Rewrote the step 10 retry rule as an explicit '3 retries, 2 seconds apart' instead of pointing back to the brief
Removed hedging phrases and redundant sentences (for example repeated 'customers are unaffected' explanations and 'do not improvise')
Simplified the step 3 and step 6 wording so the order of checks is easier to follow
Kept all requirements, assumptions, the failure table and the open question on rotation cadence unchanged in substance
